narrationTexts: Confirmed. Now migrating each non-vendor file's `db.query(sql, params)` calls to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.
Verifying no `db.query` calls remain outside vendor.
finalText:
**Migration done.**

Moved 11 files, 33 calls, from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:
[sla.js](packages/support/src/repo/sla.js), `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `session.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `returnService.js`, `refund.js`, `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`.

Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says it's overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, so edits there don't survive.

Next: nothing.
